Skagit Valley Winery & Event Estate - For Sale $975,000
18.5 acres, Mount Vernon, WA 98273, Skagit County
Licensed winery with tasting room and a permitted wedding and event venue hosting up to 150 guests.
Zoning: Rural Resource-NRL with conditional use permit for events.
4,200 sq ft event barn with catering kitchen; commercial kitchen permitted by county health.
Main home 3 bed / 2 bath plus a 1 bed ADU guest cottage. Paved road frontage on Highway 9.
Year-round creek along the north line. Well and irrigation water rights. No HOA.
